create_StableUnCLIPPipeline: create a StableUnCLIPPipeline instance with prior transformer, tokenizer, text encoder, and prior scheduler
run_StableUnCLIPPipeline_call: run the StableUnCLIPPipeline __call__ method to generate images from text prompts using prior and decoder stages
encode_prompt_StableUnCLIPPipeline: encode text prompts into CLIP embeddings with optional precomputed text model output and attention mask
encode_image_StableUnCLIPPipeline: encode image inputs into batched image embeddings with optional unconditional embeddings for classifier-free guidance
prepare_latents_StableUnCLIPPipeline: prepare random or provided latents scaled by scheduler noise sigma for prior diffusion steps
